sections.body: Internal treatment only. Ask customer for hot spots. Go straight to treatment.

sections.title: Heavy activity in cupboards with food/linen?
sections.body: Ask to empty. If they can't, note the limitation on job report.

sections.heading: Products
rows: Cracks, crevices, hinges, power point cavities, behind/under furniture, kickboards, under bench crevices, dishwasher hose hole, roof void
Light dust: behind/under furniture, under bottom drawer, kickboards. Powder blower through weep holes & enclosed subfloor.
All skirting boards. High pressure, clean start/stop. No dripping. No cornices on cockroach-only jobs.
Pea-sized dots in cracks & harborage points only if customer asks.

sections.heading: Where to treat (internal only)
rows: Under/behind all appliances, under sink, hinges, drawer runners, under bottom drawer, crevices under benches, kickboards, dishwasher hose hole.
Under vanity, toilet base, pipe penetrations, mirror cabinet.
Behind/under washer & dryer, pipe penetrations, skirting.
All accessible skirting boards: light Rega spray.
Remove cover, quick Astro into cavity, replace.
Light Astro & powder behind/under large furniture.
Shelf undersides & corners if emptied by customer.
Astro & powder around pipe penetrations. NOTE if no access.
Powder blower if enclosed. NOTE if no access.

sections.heading: Job complete when
items: Roof void & subfloor done or noted on job report
Untreated areas noted on job report
Any other pest activity flagged to customer
Customer briefed on re-entry & what to expect

items.a: Yes. Synthetic pyrethroids, plant-derived, low-tox. Less than supermarket fly spray. Targeted, not blanketed. Safe once dry, about an hour. [Mitch to confirm this wording]
Normal. Takes 2 to 3 weeks. May see more at first as they contact the product. Still active after 3 weeks? Call us, we'll come back.
Interior treatment lasts several months. We recommend a service every 6 to 12 months to stay on top of it.

sections.body: Internal only. No exterior on this job. Note all untreated areas on report.
